text: M2 still reproduces on origin/main 8e85ef61. Reproduction: PilotRunnerSuite 'probe M2a' and 'probe M2b' (added in e2f82604), run against the unmodified 8e85ef61 sources. A job in flight at or above the highest completed index is skipped on a resume past the soft stop, so D=2 instead of 3. The fix (durable dispatch markers) is on work/phrf-s7-reconcile e2f82604, unpushed and unlanded; main stays affected until it lands after review. H1 and M4 do not reproduce on main.
